india.one_line: India's AI landscape expands with record ChatGPT usage, new foundation models, and AI‑driven wealth startup funding.

themes.title: India leads ChatGPT usage
themes.text: OpenAI reports India has the highest weekly active user count for ChatGPT worldwide, with the user base doubling since January 2026, and is expanding local computing capacity, Indian-language features, Android‑first products, and plans UPI‑related announcements.

stories.headline: India becomes ChatGPT’s largest market by weekly active users, base doubles since Jan 2026

themes.title: IndiaAI Mission releases models
themes.text: The IndiaAI Mission unveiled three domestically developed foundation models—EKA‑1, a 26.3‑billion‑parameter multilingual model, and Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B, open‑source assistants for on‑premise and offline use—at a New Delhi event on Nov 3.

stories.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models

themes.title: PowerUp Money secures funding
themes.text: Bengaluru startup PowerUp Money raised $10 million, led by Flourish Ventures, to expand its AI‑powered wealth advisory platform and grow its managed advisory service, which holds nearly Rs 500 crore AUM.

stories.headline: PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India
